sentences.text: Dota 2 includes random events to keep the game unpredictable, but pseudo-random distribution (PRD) replaces true random distribution where developers wanted to limit huge streaks.
Under PRD the event's chance increases each time it fails to occur but starts lower than the listed chance as compensation, giving lower variance and a concave distribution.
The probability on the N-th test since the last proc is P(N) = C · N, where the constant increment C is also the initial probability and the counter resets once the effect occurs.
The event is guaranteed on the first trial where C · N ≥ 1, i.e. N ≥ 1/C.
For melee Skull Basher's 25% Bash, C = 8.47%: the first attack has ~8.5%, the second ~17%, the third ~25.5%, and the 12th attempt is the ensured proc, averaging out to nearly 25%.
Instances that could not trigger the effect do not increase the counter (critical strike attacking buildings), and the chance is neither reset nor increased while the ability is on cooldown.
Approximate C values include 0.38% for a nominal 5%, 1.5% for 10%, 8.5% for 25%, 30% for 50%, 67% for 75% and 95% for 95%.
All evasion sources and the drop chance of neutral items use pseudo-random distribution.

PRD-based effects include Chaos Strike, Time Lock, Backtrack, Blade Dance, Moment of Courage, Coup de Grace, Juxtapose, Headshot, Greater Bash, Crystalys/Daedalus crits, Maelstrom-family Chain Lightning, Radiance Burn and Vanguard/Crimson Guard/Abyssal Blade damage block.

True random flat distribution rolls a value between 0 and 1 along a min–max gradient, covering attack damage ranges, last hit gold bounty, Roshan's respawn timer, Chaos Bolt, Doppelganger's 325 reappear radius and Freezing Field's 195–785 explosion distance.
Discrete random events include powerup runes over 6 types and 2 locations, neutral camp spawns, illusion formation positions, and target selection for effects like Chain Frost and Paralyzing Cask.
Legacy WC3 DotA data for a nominal 25% chance gives actual probability 24.9%, C = 0.08475, Max N 12, average N 4.02 and SD 1.90 versus 3.49 under true random.
